key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence enabled stronger perovskite reasoning and guided a contact-material choice that outperformed the expert-preferred alternative.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could help prioritize perovskite device experiments, with the selected contact yielding 27.05% efficiency and 96.74% efficiency retention after 1,000 hours at 85°C in dark thermal ageing.
method: Build PSM-Bench: 800 expert-developed questions on perovskite photovoltaics.
Adapt OpenPerov using evidence records reconstructed from 4,035 articles, linking strategies, controls, observations and mechanisms.
Refine selected answers with retrieved evidence and experimentally test a recommended self-assembled monolayer analogue.
evidence_signal: OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted OpenPerov Pro increased Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1.
watch_item: The reported thermal-ageing result does not establish durability under illumination, humidity or outdoor operating conditions.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
